Summary: TECHNOLOGY: granted-patent assignee from the USPTO PatentsView table (ASSIGNEE_OF_GRANTED_PATENT), by exact legal name and by subsidiaries named in the company's own 10-K Exhibit 21
Description: 1) Original intent: TECHNOLOGY had no admitted relationship type. The Founder ratified (2026-10-13) patent assignment narrowly: the USPTO record confirms a granted patent and the assignee's exact legal name matches the already-resolved company; later the same day the Exhibit 21 subsidiary rule (a subsidiary named exactly in the company's own latest 10-K Exhibit 21). 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) type ASSIGNEE_OF_GRANTED_PATENT, part = (company by SEC CIK or GLEIF LEI, patent node PATENT:US<number>); (b) a patent is admitted only when its assignee equals the SEC registered name for the company's CIK (case, punctuation and Corp/Corporation spelling ignored; a different legal form is a different entity), or equals exactly a subsidiary the company's own Exhibit 21 names, with the exhibit's accession, filing date and filer CIK cited; (c) wording names the subsidiary when it is one; (d) the file's date and the 2025-12-31 data cutoff are stated, a missing file is stated and never read as no patents; (e) real USPTO file read through an in-memory index built at engine start. 3) Current implementation state: built and tested (qa_patent_assignee 48, qa_legalnamekey 6) on the real pvgpatdis file; C05, C27, R06, R16 score 10 from it. Local commits only; /api/patent-assignee is not exposed in production and the 1.1 GB file is not on the VPS. 4) Dependencies: g_assignee_disambiguated.tsv.zip from ODP dataset pvgpatdis in as-diff/data/patentsview (gitignored); SEC company_tickers and Exhibit 21; for deploy an nginx location block for the new routes and the file on the server. 5) Superseded by: nothing. 6) Maps to the product model: yes, TECHNOLOGY domain, relationship substrate.

Summary: KNOWLEDGE: granted patents also support KNOWLEDGE coverage, labelled as patent-derived evidence only, forming no cross-domain link
Description: 1) Original intent: Founder ratified narrowly (2026-10-13): existing admitted patent relationships may also support KNOWLEDGE alongside TECHNOLOGY when the report explicitly identifies them as patent-derived knowledge evidence, without implying research impact, author affiliation or other unsupported claims. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) KNOWLEDGE counts toward coverage for a company with admitted patents; (b) it forms no cross-domain link, so no link wording implies research impact; (c) a synthesis statement and the formation sentence say it is patent-derived and name what it does not establish. 3) Current implementation state: built and tested in qa_patent_assignee; R14 (Intel knowledge) scores 10. 4) Dependencies: the patents ticket. 5) Superseded by: nothing. 6) Maps to the product model: yes.

Summary: Identity: GLEIF identity class for the patent producer (KRYL-1417) and Anduril
Description: 1) Original intent: Anduril Industries, Inc. has no SEC filings; the only SEC registrants named Anduril are investment vehicles (different legal entities). The Founder ratified (2026-10-13) a GLEIF identity class for identity resolution supporting the patent producer only. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) the entity carries an LEI confirmed by an authoritative GLEIF record that is ACTIVE and ISSUED with the exact legal name; (b) the patent producer runs only when the live record for that LEI confirms the entity; patents match the GLEIF legal name exactly; (c) no investor vehicle or similar name is bound; (d) a GLEIF record is identity only, never evidence of financing, officers or relationships; (e) an unresolved subject lists GLEIF among the sources checked. 3) Current implementation state: built and tested (qa_gleif_identity 36); Anduril is resolved and its patents admitted (PC07 scores 7; PC08 5). 4) Dependencies: api.gleif.org reachable from the engine; the curated LEI in the registry. 5) Superseded by: nothing. 6) Maps to the product model: yes (identity substrate).

Summary: MEDIA: dated GDELT article observation naming the company's SEC registered name (KRYL-1418)
Description: 1) Original intent: Founder ratified (2026-10-13) a dated MEDIA observation from an article naming Verizon Communications, quoting the source as stated, with no relationship or event connection inferred. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) per article (newest 5): title, domain, URL and first-seen date as GDELT states them; (b) never a relationship; polarity absent; the article text is not read; (c) a GDELT failure including its rate limit is a failure, never no articles. 3) Current implementation state: built and tested (qa_media_observation 17); applies to every company resolved by an SEC CIK. GDELT rate-limits repeated calls (one per 5 seconds), so live answers are intermittent. R12 stays at 6: the frozen rubric credits a domain only through an admitted relationship. 4) Dependencies: api.gdeltproject.org; SEC registered name. 5) Superseded by: nothing. 6) Maps to the product model: yes, MEDIA domain as an observation.
